decision.reason: [ev-f44aa981165a] is only a table-of-contents entry. The section text [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] says to upgrade providers to v2 versions that support both namespaced and cluster-scoped managed resources, and that existing cluster-scoped MRs "continue working unchanged". Nothing in the evidence says that skipping this step makes anything fail, get rejected or stop working, so the action-eligible kind migration-required is over-claimed, and the proposal's own statement admits this. To decide the consequence we would need upstream text saying what happens when pre-v2 providers keep running on Crossplane v2 core, for example whether they stop working or only lack namespaced MR support.
